description: Run the Valdez Tanker (VALD) demo — Koelling-Remy 1983 Alaska Pipeline model, the paradigm-integration motivator. Crude flows continuously into the Valdez Marine Terminal storage tank (Flow); tankers arrive discretely to drain it (Item); DRS handles both via F2I / I2F transitions. Returns engine output including tanker arrival/departure events and tank-level trace. ANTI-FABRICATION: numbers come from a real engine run; quote verbatim.
